papers.title: SPLENDID incorporates continuous genetic ancestry in biobank-scale data to improve polygenic risk prediction across diverse populations
papers.summary: Rather than relying on pre-specified ancestry labels, which often fail to capture the full genetic heterogeneity of diverse populations, SPLENDID treats ancestry as a continuum and improves polygenic risk score (PRS) prediction for biobank-scale datasets
papers.llm_title_zh: SPLENDID系统将连续的遗传谱系信息整合到生物样本库规模的数据中，从而提升对不同人群中多基因风险因素的预测能力。

papers.llm_research_question_zh: 与那些通常无法准确反映多种人群遗传多样性的预设祖先分类标签不同，SPLENDID将祖先身份视为一个连续体，并由此显著提升了针对生物样本库规模数据集的多基因风险评分预测精度。
llm_highlights_zh: SPLENDID系统将连续的遗传谱系信息整合到生物样本库规模的数据中，从而提升对不同人群中多基因风险因素的预测能力。

papers.title: CFM: confinement force microscopy—a dynamic, precise and stable microconfiner for traction force microscopy in spatial confinement
papers.summary: CFM enables tunable cell confinement for measuring traction forces exerted by single cells and cell aggregates in tissue-mimicking microenvironments
papers.llm_title_zh: CFM：约束力显微镜——一种用于空间受限环境下的牵引力测量的动态、精确且稳定的微约束装置。
